2760-4279-6794.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
2760-4279-6794.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2760-4279-6794.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

1168-3510-5929-8168.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Leyline of Transformation.
1168-3510-5929-8168.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each permanent that entered is a Saproling through Leyline of Transformation and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Toggo to trigger.
Resolve a Toggo trigger, replacing the artifact token creation with that many 5/5 Dragons through Draconic Visitor.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

751-4289-7060.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

339-677-7175-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
339-677-7175-8227.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Loot by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2558-3698-4186-6689-8181.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Grinding Station and Golbez trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sword of the Meek, causing a player to mill three cards.
Resolve the Golbez trigger, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Squirrel.
Repeat from step 2.

1453-4694-5147-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1453-4694-5147-7306.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to its target.
Repeat from step 1.

728-856-5776-7422.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Garrison Excavator trigger.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

851-2097-5660-6462-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

1409-5963-6586.description:
Activate Marvin using Vivi's ability by paying {0}, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Marvin enters the battlefield, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Marvin.
Repeat.

2558-6797-7422--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-6797-7422--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Garrison Excavator triggers. Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a 2/2 creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

5309-5856-5903.description:
Activate an artifact using Black Market Tycoon's ability by tapping it, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat step 1 using the Treasure token.

1718-4477-4924-7182.description:
Cast Greenwarden of Murasa for its evoke cost by paying {2} due to Heartless Summoning.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Catalyst Elemental from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa with haste.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters, it triggers, returning Greenwarden of Murasa from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Catalyst Elemental by paying {R} due to Heartless Summoning.
Activate Catalyst Elemental by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
When Catalyst Elemental dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Catalyst Elemental with haste.
Activate the Catalyst Elemental token by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.
1718-4477-4924-7182.notes: If you have at least {2}{R} in your mana pool on a particular iteration, step 10 can be skipped.

1456-2033-3459-5078.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

11-121-6069-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-121-6069-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Alchemist's Gambit by paying its cleave cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Alchemist's Gambit.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Alchemist's Gambit spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Alchemist's Gambit spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Alchemist's Gambit and returning the original Alchemist's Gambit to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Alchemist's Gambit from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

141-413-3505.description:
Cast Second Sunrise by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it and Blasting Station triggers, with Naru Meha targeting Second Sunrise.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Second Sunrise
Resolve the Second Sunrise copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

465-5231-6132.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Repeat from step 3.

5051-5078-6006-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
5051-5078-6006-6650.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

880-6529-6763.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-6529-6763.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the land enters the battlefield, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2457-2837-4289-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 2/2 Cat creature tokens with haste.
Activate the Cats by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1810-2743-6231.manaNeeded: {2}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell
1810-2743-6231.notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
1810-2743-6231.description:
Activate Thunderclap Drake by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing it.
Cast Cackling Counterpart by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Thunderclap Drake triggers, copying Cackling Counterpart at least twice, with all copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Cackling Counterpart spells, creating at least three copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.

1170-2450-2834-6586.description:
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}.
Displacer Kitten and Vivi trigger.
Resolve the Vivi trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Holding priority, activate Vivi by paying {0}, adding at least {U}{U/R}{U/R}{U/R}.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Vivi.
When Vivi enters the battlefield, Hero's Blade triggers, attaching Hero's Blade to Vivi.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning Whim of Volrath to your hand.
Repeat.

1940-2921-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1940-2921-6249--5.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger.
Resolve the Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

186-4222-4758-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Red Death.
186-4222-4758-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

1116-3240-3330-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1116-3240-3330-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
When the Graveborn enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Nether Traitor enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

1978-2364-4694.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Mana Vault.
Repeat.

38-3101-3705-5465.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Runaway Steam-Kin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
If Runaway Steam-Kin has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, activate it by removing three +1/+1 counters on it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1563-2457-2837-4772.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 2/2 Cat creature tokens with haste.
Activate the Cats by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

433-654-3478-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Llanowar Scout.
Llanowar Scout does not have summoning sickness.
433-654-3478-3525.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Dimir Aqueduct onto the battlefield from your hand.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Dimir Aqueduct.
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger from step 2, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Repeat.

1247-1912-4289.notablePrerequisites: Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
1247-1912-4289.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {1} due to Biomancer's Familiar and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

2635-3685-3717.notablePrerequisites: Viridian Joiner does not have summoning sickness.
2635-3685-3717.description:
Activate Viridian Joiner by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} equal to its power.
Cast Spine of Ish Sah by paying {7}.
Raggadragga's third ability triggers, giving Viridian Joiner +7/+7 until end of turn and untapping Viridian Joiner.
When Spine of Ish Sah enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, destroying itself.
When Spine of Ish Sah leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning itself to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1000-2567-2743.manaNeeded: {5}{G}{G}{U}, plus an additional {1} if Mystic Reflection was not foretold
1000-2567-2743.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three lands.
1000-2567-2743.description:
Cast Avenger of Zendikar by paying {5}{G}{G}.
Avenger of Zendikar enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, cast Mystic Reflection by paying {1}{U}, causing the next creatures or planeswalkers to enter the battlefield this turn to enter as copies of Biovisionary.
Resolve the Avenger of Zendikar trigger, creating at least three Biovisionary tokens.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

224-2248-4300.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
224-2248-4300.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Repeat.

1309-3742-4377.notablePrerequisites: An opponent can not block Phantom Steed.
1309-3742-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons, taking an extra turn after this one.
Attack with Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Salvager of Secrets that is tapped and attacking.
Salvager of Secrets enters, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

57-1402-1897-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Feldon of the Third Path does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Feldon of the Third Path.
Each of your opponents has at least one card in hand.
57-1402-1897-2178.description:
Activate Feldon of the Third Path by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Diamond Lion with haste.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, discarding your hand, and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Thornbite Staff and Stalking Vengeance both trigger.
Resolve the Vicious Shadows trigger, dealing damage to target player equal to the number of cards in their hand.
Resolve the Thornbite Staff trigger, untapping Feldon of the Third Path.
Repeat.

4393-5276.description:
Cast Dance of Many, targeting Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Dance of Many enters the battlefield, it creates a token copy of Leonin Relic-Warder.
The token enters, exiling Dance of the Many.
Dance of Many leaves the battlefield, triggering to exile the token.
The token triggers, returning Dance of Many to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2-5.

3957-4210-4702.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
Splinter Twin attached to Famished Paladin.
3957-4210-4702.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to create a token copy of it with haste.
The token ETBs, triggering Pious Evangel and gaining you 1 life.
All of your Famished Paladins trigger, untapping themselves.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens with haste.

391-2605-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Blossom Dryad does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Blossom Dryad.
391-2605-4222.description:
Activate Lotus Vale by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Lotus Vale.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Repeat any number of times.
Repeat steps with a different color for infinite mana of any color.
